subject: [Candidate packet] Project prompt release, submission window & reviewer cadence
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: TalentFlow Recruiter <recruiter@talentflow.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: [Candidate packet] Project prompt release, submission window & reviewer cadence

Hi Samir —

Thanks for taking the time to interview with us last week. As discussed, attached is the candidate project packet that covers the prompt, deliverable expectations, and evaluation rubric. A few notes up front: 

- Submission window: please submit by Wed, Oct 7, 2026 23:59 PT.
- Format: PDF or a zip with source + README.
- Deliverables: brief design doc (max 2 pages), code or runnable demo, and a short write-up of tradeoffs.
- Estimated time: 3–5 hours. If you think you'll need more time, let us know.

Attachments: assignment_packet.md (project prompt), reviewer_checklist.pdf

Next steps: please confirm receipt and tell us if the deadline works. We'll assign two reviewers (backend & infra) and aim to return feedback within 3 business days after submission.

Appreciate it — looking forward to your work.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Thanks, I got the packet and can start working on it.
